adception-claude-mac-2026-10.title: Adception fake Claude for Mac InstallFix malvertising
adception-claude-mac-2026-10.summary: A Google ad for 'claude mac' leads to a fake Claude download page whose Copy button swaps the real install command for one that pipes an attacker URL into zsh.

agentcorruption-bedrock-2026-10.title: AgentCorruption: AWS Bedrock AgentCore IMDS credential theft
agentcorruption-bedrock-2026-10.summary: Research disclosure: chat prompts to exposed AgentCore agents could reach IMDS and steal region-wide role credentials, exposing other agents, memories and secrets. AWS has tightened defaults.

anthropic-influence-as-a-service-2025-03.title: Claude-orchestrated influence-as-a-service bot network
anthropic-influence-as-a-service-2025-03.summary: A provider report describes an operation using Claude to coordinate over 100 social bot accounts and generate responses. The source does not confirm state affiliation.

anthropic-iot-camera-cred-scrape-2025-03.title: Claude-assisted IoT security camera credential scraping toolkit
anthropic-iot-camera-cred-scrape-2025-03.summary: An actor used Claude to build tooling that tests leaked IoT camera credentials against internet-facing devices. Anthropic did not confirm successful real-world deployment.

anthropic-novice-malware-builder-2025-03.title: Novice actor uses Claude to build a GUI malware builder
anthropic-novice-malware-builder-2025-03.summary: A low-skill actor used Claude to advance from batch scripts to a malware builder focused on evasion and persistence. Anthropic did not confirm real-world deployment.

anthropic-recruitment-fraud-2025-03.title: Claude-polished recruitment fraud targeting Eastern Europe
anthropic-recruitment-fraud-2025-03.summary: Recruitment scammers posing as hiring managers used Claude to polish their English and interview scripts. Anthropic did not confirm that any victims were successfully defrauded.

anyrun-fake-ai-tools-2026-10.title: Fake AI tools campaign cluster (ANY.RUN)
anyrun-fake-ai-tools-2026-10.summary: 1,258 sandbox runs tied to fake Claude, ChatGPT and other AI lures delivered stealers through paste-in commands, ClickFix, shared AI chats, trojanized installers and fake browser ads.

apex-accelerator-ref8801-2026-10.title: Apex Accelerator / REF8801 backdoored AI CLI and MCP packages
apex-accelerator-ref8801-2026-10.summary: A fake Web3 accelerator's npm packages route AI traffic to an attacker proxy, register rogue MCP servers in AI IDEs, and drop stealers on Windows and macOS.

apt41-gemini-c2-osstun-2025-08.title: APT41 uses Gemini to develop the OSSTUN C2 framework
apt41-gemini-c2-osstun-2025-08.summary: PRC-linked APT41 used Gemini for C++ and Go coding help on tools, including the OSSTUN C2 framework, and for help with public obfuscation libraries.

apt42-gemini-phishing-data-agent-2025.title: APT42 uses Gemini for phishing and a 'Data Processing Agent'
apt42-gemini-phishing-data-agent-2025.summary: Iranian APT42 used Gemini to draft phishing lures and attempted to build an agent that turns natural language into SQL queries over sensitive personal data.

arup-deepfake-video-fraud-2024-01.title: Arup Hong Kong deepfake video-call fraud (~US$25.6M)
arup-deepfake-video-fraud-2024-01.summary: A finance employee on a video call with deepfaked executives approved transfers of about US$25.6M. Arup said its internal IT systems were not compromised.

c2agent-unit42-2026-10.title: C2Agent LLM-driven Windows implant
c2agent-unit42-2026-10.summary: Analysis of a Go Windows implant run by a C2-side LLM that turns operator goals into tool calls. It supports MCP, skills, handoff to AI coding CLIs on the host, and Cobalt Strike BOFs.

cairn-norforge-2026-10.title: Cairn: coding agents automate web exploitation
cairn-norforge-2026-10.summary: Exposed operator panels revealed coding agents repeatedly attempting known web exploits against commerce and payment sites. Success was reported for roughly 10% of tasks.

cert-in-crafty-falcon-bfsi-2026-11.title: CRAFTY FALCON campaign against Indian finance
cert-in-crafty-falcon-bfsi-2026-11.summary: CERT-In CIAD-2026-0058 and CIAD-2026-0062 describe CRAFTY FALCON and later unauthorized payments against Indian finance, government-linked payment providers, and payout platforms.

cl-unk-1211-unit42-2026-10.title: CL-UNK-1211 AI-assisted campaign on government Linux servers
cl-unk-1211-unit42-2026-10.summary: Espionage-style intrusions on government Linux servers used web shells, privilege escalation, SysGoRAT and tunnels. The code looks LLM-generated, but a live AI operator is not confirmed.

claude-agent-sdk-cve-2026-96620.title: Claude Agent SDK session-ID MCP code execution (CVE-2026-96620)
claude-agent-sdk-cve-2026-96620.summary: Untrusted session IDs starting with '-' were parsed as CLI flags, letting attackers load an MCP server that runs outside SDK permission controls. CVSS 9.2.

copilot-autoapprove-cve-2025-53773.title: GitHub Copilot prompt injection enables auto-approve RCE (CVE-2025-53773)
copilot-autoapprove-cve-2025-53773.summary: Prompt injection could make Copilot turn on auto-approve in its settings and then run shell commands without confirmation on Windows, macOS and Linux. Patched in VS 2022 17.14.12.

crowdstrike-artex-sk-finance-2026-10.title: ARTEX and Claude Code used against South Korean financial firms
crowdstrike-artex-sk-finance-2026-10.summary: A likely Chinese-speaking actor used the ARTEX agentic pentest suite and Claude Code against South Korean financial organizations, and asked Claude where to sell the stolen data.

cursor-curxecute-cve-2025-54135.title: Cursor CurXecute code execution (CVE-2025-54135)
cursor-curxecute-cve-2025-54135.summary: A Cursor IDE flaw in AI and MCP handling enabled code execution. It was fixed alongside MCPoison in the Cursor 1.3.x line.

cursor-mcpoison-cve-2025-54136.title: Cursor MCPoison persistent MCP trust bypass (CVE-2025-54136)
cursor-mcpoison-cve-2025-54136.summary: After a victim approved a benign MCP config, an attacker could swap in a reverse shell that ran on every project open without a new prompt. Fixed in Cursor 1.3.

cve-2025-10619-sequa-mcp.title: sequa-mcp OAuth URL command injection (CVE-2025-10619)
cve-2025-10619-sequa-mcp.summary: Another MCP client affected by the same flaw class, where opening an OAuth authorization URL allows Windows command injection.

cve-2025-58062-openmcp-client.title: openmcp-client OAuth URL command injection (CVE-2025-58062)
cve-2025-58062-openmcp-client.summary: On Windows, openmcp-client mishandled the MCP OAuth authorization URL, allowing PowerShell command injection. This is the same flaw class as mcp-remote and opencode.

cve-2025-6514-mcp-remote-rce.title: mcp-remote OAuth authorization_endpoint RCE (CVE-2025-6514)
cve-2025-6514-mcp-remote-rce.summary: A malicious or intercepted MCP server could return a crafted OAuth URL that runs commands through PowerShell on Windows. CVSS 9.6; fixed in mcp-remote 0.1.16.

datadog-bedrock-key-testing-2025.title: Exposed AWS keys mass-tested for Bedrock LLMjacking
datadog-bedrock-key-testing-2025.summary: Datadog observed automated, internet-scale testing of exposed AWS keys specifically for Amazon Bedrock model access, a reconnaissance step toward LLMjacking.

deepseek-grok-fake-windows-clients-2025.title: Fake DeepSeek and Grok Windows clients deliver stealers and backdoors
deepseek-grok-fake-windows-clients-2025.summary: Fake DeepSeek and Grok desktop installers delivered stealers, SSH backdoors, Vidar, the BrowserVenom traffic proxy and Gh0stRAT variants.

eset-rilide-vidar-fake-ai-2024.title: Rilide and Vidar stealers spread via fake Sora, Gemini and Midjourney
eset-rilide-vidar-fake-ai-2024.summary: Fake AI ads and a malicious extension delivered the Rilide stealer for Facebook credentials, and a fake Midjourney installer delivered Vidar to steal browser data, wallets and keystrokes.

evilai-trendmicro-fake-ai-apps-2025.title: EvilAI: fake AI apps steal browser data
evilai-trendmicro-fake-ai-apps-2025.summary: Signed, working productivity apps hide browser-data theft and other malicious behavior. Researchers described the code as AI-generated-looking; that does not independently establish AI authorship.

fraudgpt-underground-2023.title: FraudGPT underground malicious LLM offering
fraudgpt-underground-2023.summary: A dark-web LLM advertised for malware, phishing kits and scam content. This is a marketplace claim, and some researchers doubt its authenticity.

ghostaction-ai-creds-2026-10.title: GhostAction Stage 2 stealer targeting cloud and AI credentials
ghostaction-ai-creds-2026-10.summary: Malicious workflows and a VS Code auto-run task steal AWS, npm, SSH and Claude/Gemini credentials across 94 repos. AI is a credential target here, not the attack operator.

gtg-1002-anthropic-claude-code-espionage.title: GTG-1002 AI-orchestrated espionage via Claude Code
gtg-1002-anthropic-claude-code-espionage.summary: Anthropic reports that a state-sponsored group used Claude Code to orchestrate intrusion tasks. Human operators selected targets, and model-generated findings required validation.

gtg-2002-vibe-hacking-extortion-2025-08.title: GTG-2002 'vibe hacking' data extortion via Claude Code
gtg-2002-vibe-hacking-extortion-2025-08.summary: A criminal operator used Claude Code for reconnaissance, intrusion and data theft, then to help set ransom amounts and prepare extortion messages.

hiddenlayer-mcp-param-abuse-2025.title: HiddenLayer: MCP tool parameter abuse leaks prompts
hiddenlayer-mcp-param-abuse-2025.summary: Research showed malicious MCP tools with suggestive parameter names can trick models into filling in system prompts and chat history, which the tool then exfiltrates.

huntress-plus56-custom-gpt-clickfix-2026.title: Plus 5.6 Custom GPT ClickFix and ROMULUS
huntress-plus56-custom-gpt-clickfix-2026.summary: Custom GPT ClickFix later tied to ROMULUS.

hyas-blackmamba-poc-2023-08.title: BlackMamba AI-generated polymorphic keylogger (PoC)
hyas-blackmamba-poc-2023-08.summary: A research proof of concept asks an LLM for fresh in-memory keylogger code on each run and demonstrates exfiltration through Teams. The report describes a lab demo, not an observed campaign.

invariant-github-mcp-private-repo-2025-0.title: GitHub MCP prompt injection leaks private repositories
invariant-github-mcp-private-repo-2025-0.summary: Research showed a malicious public GitHub issue can coerce an agent using GitHub MCP to leak private repo contents publicly. The root cause is an architectural trust issue, not a code bug.

invariant-mcp-tool-poisoning-2025-04.title: MCP tool poisoning attacks (Invariant Labs)
invariant-mcp-tool-poisoning-2025-04.summary: Research showed hidden instructions in MCP tool descriptions can make agents leak SSH keys and configs. It also showed rug pulls and cross-server email redirection.

kimjen-krrk-artex-korean-universities-20.title: KimJEN used ARTEX against Korean universities
kimjen-krrk-artex-korean-universities-20.summary: S2W says KimJEN (krrk) used ARTEX against shared Webcash rERP at Korean universities, then pulled UNIVais logins and bank details and defaced subdomains as Hacked by KRRK.

llmjacking-deepseek-sysdig-2025-02.title: LLMjacking expands to DeepSeek
llmjacking-deepseek-sysdig-2025-02.summary: Within days of DeepSeek going viral, LLMjacking proxies running on stolen credentials added DeepSeek alongside OpenAI, AWS and Azure access.

llmjacking-sysdig-2024-05.title: LLMjacking via stolen cloud credentials (Sysdig)
llmjacking-sysdig-2024-05.summary: Attackers used stolen cloud credentials to probe ten AI services and resell LLM access through proxies, leaving victims to pay the inference bills.

lolskills-ink5725-snapshot-config-reader.title: ink5725/snapshot-config-reader agent skill scanner finding
lolskills-ink5725-snapshot-config-reader.summary: A skill that extracts config from PNG images triggered scanner flags. The snapshot showed zero downloads and an incomplete scan; the finding does not establish that the skill is malicious.

malwarebytes-chrome-ai-extensions-2025-0.title: Chrome AI extensions deliver info-stealers
malwarebytes-chrome-ai-extensions-2025-0.summary: Compromised or malicious AI- and VPN-themed Chrome extensions pushed info-stealers through updates, reportedly affecting about 2.6 million users.

morris-ii-ai-worm-poc-2024-03.title: Morris II generative AI email worm (research PoC)
morris-ii-ai-worm-poc-2024-03.summary: In controlled tests, self-replicating prompts spread between GenAI email assistants, demonstrating potential propagation and data-theft risks.

openai-phish-and-scripts-2025-10.title: OpenAI disruption: 'Phish and Scripts' cyber cluster
openai-phish-and-scripts-2025-10.summary: Chinese-language accounts used ChatGPT for phishing and malware help and researched further automation with DeepSeek, an example of switching between models.

openai-russian-malware-tooling-2025-10.title: OpenAI disruption: Russian-speaking malware tooling development
openai-russian-malware-tooling-2025-10.summary: Russian-speaking operators used ChatGPT to develop and debug malware tooling as part of their existing cyber workflows.

openai-scopecreep-cyber-2025-06.title: OpenAI disruption: ScopeCreep cyber operation
openai-scopecreep-cyber-2025-06.summary: OpenAI disrupted an operation that used ChatGPT to support intrusion and malware work. The AI was added to existing workflows rather than running attacks end to end.

opencode-mcp-oauth-rce-2026-10.title: opencode remote MCP OAuth command execution
opencode-mcp-oauth-rce-2026-10.summary: A malicious remote MCP server can return an OAuth URL that runs commands via PowerShell when opencode opens it on Windows or WSL. No prompt injection is needed.

ox-security-chrome-ext-chatgpt-deepseek-.title: Malicious Chrome extensions steal ChatGPT and DeepSeek chats
ox-security-chrome-ext-chatgpt-deepseek-.summary: Chrome extensions posing as AITOPIA stole ChatGPT and DeepSeek conversations and browsing URLs. The related cluster reportedly affected over 900,000 users.

phantomraven-npm-slopsquatting-2025-10.title: PhantomRaven npm campaign using slopsquatted package names
phantomraven-npm-slopsquatting-2025-10.summary: Malicious npm packages with AI-hallucination-style names hid dependencies from scanners and stole npm, Git and CI tokens.

pretext-skill-scanner-evasion-2026-10.title: Pretext: LLM attacker evades agent-skill scanners
pretext-skill-scanner-evasion-2026-10.summary: Academic research: plain-language payloads split across skill files evaded skill scanners up to 97% of the time, showing whole bundles must be scanned. This is not a real intrusion.

profero-ultra-operator-artex-2026-10.title: Profero Ultra operator and AI-triage canaries
profero-ultra-operator-artex-2026-10.summary: Profero describes an unnamed operator running ARTEX, VulnHunter, Hermes Agent, and earlier CyberStrikeAI, and canary text that a victim AI report treated as an authorized test.

promptflux-gtig-2025-06.title: PROMPTFLUX Gemini-powered self-modifying VBScript dropper
promptflux-gtig-2025-06.summary: An experimental VBScript dropper queries Gemini for antivirus-evasion rewrites. The analyzed self-update function was commented out, so active self-rewriting is not established.

promptlock-gtig-eset-2025.title: PROMPTLOCK LLM-generated Lua ransomware (PoC)
promptlock-gtig-eset-2025.summary: A Go ransomware proof of concept uses an LLM to generate Lua scripts for recon, data theft and encryption on Windows and Linux. It has not been reported as an active campaign.

promptsteal-lamehug-apt28-2025-07.title: PROMPTSTEAL / LAMEHUG LLM-driven data miner (APT28)
promptsteal-lamehug-apt28-2025-07.summary: Malware that asks a Hugging Face-hosted LLM for Windows recon and document-theft commands was used against Ukrainian government targets. GTIG calls it the first LLM-querying malware seen in live operations.

quietvault-gtig-2025.title: QUIETVAULT AI-assisted credential stealer
quietvault-gtig-2025.summary: A JavaScript stealer takes GitHub and npm tokens and uses AI CLIs installed on the host to hunt for more secrets. Industry reports link it to s1ngularity-style npm attacks.

s1ngularity-nx-ai-cli-2025-08.title: s1ngularity Nx npm supply-chain attack abusing AI CLIs
s1ngularity-nx-ai-cli-2025-08.summary: Malicious Nx packages stole developer secrets, using local Claude, Gemini and Amazon Q CLIs to find files. Stolen tokens later made 5,500+ private repos public.

shareleak-copilot-studio-cve-2026-21520.title: ShareLeak: Copilot Studio SharePoint form prompt injection (CVE-2026-21520)
shareleak-copilot-studio-cve-2026-21520.summary: Content in SharePoint forms could prompt-inject Copilot Studio agents into leaking SharePoint data. Microsoft patched it on 2026-01-15.

slopsquatting-huggingface-cli-2024.title: Slopsquatting: hallucinated huggingface-cli package
slopsquatting-huggingface-cli-2024.summary: Researchers registered huggingface-cli, a PyPI name LLMs often hallucinate, and saw tens of thousands of downloads. This shows how attackers could exploit AI-suggested fake packages.

socradar-oh-my-pi-php2shell-2026-11.title: Oh My Pi workers exploited PHP2Shell
socradar-oh-my-pi-php2shell-2026-11.summary: SOCRadar found Oh My Pi workers on self-hosted DeepSeek V4.1 exploiting PHP2Shell from open directories, with an autonomous payout goal and about 3.3 million Redis records taken.

storm-2139-fizzdogg-microsoft-llmjacking.title: Storm-2139 / FizzDogg Azure OpenAI LLMjacking (Microsoft DCU)
storm-2139-fizzdogg-microsoft-llmjacking.summary: A Microsoft civil action alleges the group stole Azure OpenAI credentials and bypassed safety controls to generate harmful images at victims' expense.

talos-a3-ai-analysis-evasion-2026-10.title: A3 malware that tells AI analysts to look away (Talos)
talos-a3-ai-analysis-evasion-2026-10.summary: 84 malware samples embed comments telling LLM analysts to ignore or refuse the file. In the best runs, the trick steered models toward a benign verdict about 35% of the time.

temp-zagros-gemini-malware-dev-2025.title: TEMP.Zagros / MuddyWater use Gemini for custom malware
temp-zagros-gemini-malware-dev-2025.summary: Iranian MuddyWater used 'student project' pretexts to get Gemini's help with web shells and C2. Pasting in a C2 domain and key exposed their infrastructure and aided disruption.

trailofbits-mcp-line-jumping-2025-04.title: MCP line jumping: attacks before the first tool use
trailofbits-mcp-line-jumping-2025-04.summary: Research showed malicious MCP tool descriptions can inject instructions before any tool runs, enabling code execution, data theft and approval bypass.

unc1069-gemini-deepfake-crypto-2025.title: UNC1069 (MASAN) Gemini misuse and deepfake Zoom lures
unc1069-gemini-deepfake-crypto-2025.summary: DPRK-linked UNC1069 used Gemini for crypto research and lures, and used deepfakes of crypto figures to push a fake 'Zoom SDK' that delivers the BIGMACHO backdoor.

unc4899-pukchong-gemini-2025.title: UNC4899 (PUKCHONG) uses Gemini for exploit and tooling R&D
unc4899-pukchong-gemini-2025.summary: DPRK group UNC4899 used Gemini for code development, exploit research and tooling aimed at edge devices and modern browsers.

unit42-android-chatgpt-malware-2023.title: Android malware posing as ChatGPT apps
unit42-android-chatgpt-malware-2023.summary: Fake ChatGPT Android apps delivered Meterpreter and SMS-fraud malware as ChatGPT-themed phishing and trojan sites grew.

unit42-llm-js-obfuscation-2024.title: Unit 42: LLMs obfuscate malicious JavaScript
unit42-llm-js-obfuscation-2024.summary: Research showed LLMs can effectively rewrite existing malicious JavaScript to evade detection, though writing full malware from scratch was less practical at the time.

vs-copilot-trailing-dot-rce-2026-10.title: Visual Studio / SSMS Copilot trailing-dot RCE (CVE-2026-103572)
vs-copilot-trailing-dot-rce-2026-10.summary: Writing '.mcp.json.' slipped past Copilot's edit guard, and Windows strips the trailing dot, so attackers could rewrite the MCP config for code execution. Affects VS 2022/2026 and SSMS; patched.

wiz-ai-driven-cloud-2026-10.title: Wiz CIRT: AI-driven multi-cloud intrusions
wiz-ai-driven-cloud-2026-10.summary: An AI agent ran a noisy, full multi-cloud intrusion from initial access to data theft. The same source IP scanned 600+ other Wiz customer environments.

prime-intellect-deepseek-v41-flash-ablit.title: Prime Intellect served abliterated DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash weights
prime-intellect-deepseek-v41-flash-ablit.summary: For about 53 hours an unauthorised party swapped one Prime Inference deployment for abliterated weights. Capability scores held and refusals collapsed.

wiz-artex-harvester-cyberstrikeai-cloud-.title: Wiz: ARTEX-Harvester and CyberStrikeAI cloud intrusions
wiz-artex-harvester-cyberstrikeai-cloud-.summary: Wiz reports the ARTEX-Harvester campaign and a CyberStrikeAI intrusion that used stolen CI and Kubernetes trust to reach cloud secrets, cluster-admin, and AI provider keys.

wormgpt-underground-2023.title: WormGPT underground malicious LLM
wormgpt-underground-2023.summary: An unrestricted LLM sold on dark-web forums for phishing and malware help. Check Point judged it likely real but no better than jailbroken mainstream models.

safedep-leadstack-hermes-agent-npm-backd.title: Malicious npm package installs Hermes Agent as a service
safedep-leadstack-hermes-agent-npm-backd.summary: SafeDep says @leadstack/crm-connect installed Hermes Agent, pulled a remote persona, and exposed it over Telegram. No victim count was published.

zenity-copilot-studio-sharepoint-ssrf-20.title: Copilot Studio SharePoint connector SSRF (CVE-2024-38206)
zenity-copilot-studio-sharepoint-ssrf-20.summary: A malicious agent action could expose a victim's SharePoint token through a connector SSRF flaw, enabling impersonation across affected Microsoft services.

jfrog-artex-hugging-face-self-leaking-mo.title: JFrog: ARTEX publishes Hugging Face models that leak the operator
jfrog-artex-hugging-face-self-leaking-mo.summary: An ARTEX task published fake Hugging Face models that steal loader secrets and commit them to the Hub. The first loot file was the operator's own environment.

unit42-agentic-ai-attack-campaigns-2026-.title: Unit 42: autonomous agents ran more than 10 intrusions
unit42-agentic-ai-attack-campaigns-2026-.summary: Unit 42 tracked more than 10 campaigns from July to September 2026. Humans planted web shells, and agents ran the rest, including one host that served CyberStrikeAI.

greynoise-gt13-check-point-management-se.title: GreyNoise GT13: Check Point management server intrusions
greynoise-gt13-check-point-management-se.summary: GreyNoise says GT13 hit Check Point Security Management Servers at 22 organizations from shared VPN exits and a compromised hop. It suspects agentic harnesses and names no model.

microsoft-artex-nation-state-criminal-ad.title: Microsoft: nation-state and criminal actors integrated ARTEX
microsoft-artex-nation-state-criminal-ad.summary: Microsoft says Storm-0940, Storm-3358, Onyx Sleet, Pearl Sleet, Crystal Typhoon, and Salt Typhoon integrated ARTEX. Storm-0940 reached privileged access in under three hours.

dfir-report-artex-fintech-open-directory.title: DFIR Report: ARTEX full-chain logs on fintech
dfir-report-artex-fintech-open-directory.summary: The DFIR Report recovered ARTEX logs from an open directory. A full-chain playbook produced 46 findings across dozens of fintech, crypto-payment, and iGaming targets.

ncsc-switzerland-first-ai-agent-attacks-.title: NCSC Switzerland: first confirmed AI-agent attacks
ncsc-switzerland-first-ai-agent-attacks-.summary: NCSC Switzerland says the first AI-agent attacks it has seen compromised every victim, including critical infrastructure. It does not name the agent used in those cases.

aikido-hugging-face-deepsite-phishing-pa.title: Aikido: DeepSite published phishing pages on Hugging Face
aikido-hugging-face-deepsite-phishing-pa.summary: Aikido found 42 phishing pages on Hugging Face Spaces impersonating 28 brands. DeepSite built 29 of them, and 24 commit histories are the attacker's prompts.
